name: Bench Salvage, salvage-and-compose the shipped council + pipeline into an in-process local stack
visibility: internal (product/engine track; feeds the paper-1-copilot publication track)
north_star: Build a domain-agnostic, tool-grounded eval/calibration harness for agentic-LLM outputs by COMPOSING OVER the live verification stack (:8002 /v1/pipeline/evaluate + :3031 JUTE copilot/validate + pinecone KB), with SQLite as the configuration plane and the ontology as the domain definition. Paper: replicate current state on the harness, then strengthen via tool-grounded correction of confident-but-wrong judges (S-BS-7 = exhibit). In-process salvage (M1) demoted to WS-6 compartmentalize-local.
